static_verifiable.content: 1. Figure 1: Overview of the HNSW topology leakage attack. Given only the layer-0 adjacency list from a leaked HNSW index, the attacker applies degree-penalized geodesic embedding to reconstruct approximate coordinates, enabling recovery of kNN neighborhoods beyond those explicitly present in the leaked graph.
static_verifiable.reason: Figure 1 is a conceptual pipeline diagram (not a data-driven plot). The code repository fully implements the described pipeline: exp/hnsw_audit/graph/hnsw_builder.py extracts layer-0 adjacency; exp/hnsw_audit/reconstruction/edge_weights.py implements degree-penalized weighting; exp/hnsw_audit/reconstruction/geodesic_reconstruct.py implements geodesic embedding + Landmark MDS; exp/hnsw_audit/evaluation/metrics.py measures kNN recovery. The pipeline description matches the implementation.

static_verifiable.content: 1. our degree-penalized geodesic method achieves Recall@10 of 0.4164, a 28% relative improvement over the adjacency-only baseline (0.3248)
static_verifiable.reason: Both numbers verified: msmarco10k_degree_penalized/RESULTS.json (0.4164) and msmarco10k_adjacency_only/RESULTS.json (0.3248). Relative improvement: 0.4164/0.3248 - 1 = 0.282 = 28.2%, confirmed in effectiveness_evaluation_result.json.

static_verifiable.content: 2. The degree penalty provides a 52–67% relative improvement over unweighted geodesic (0.2684 vs. 0.1603 on SIFT10K; 0.4164 vs. 0.2731 on MSMARCO-10K)
static_verifiable.reason: All four numbers verified in RESULTS.json files. SIFT: 0.2684/0.1603 - 1 = 67.4%; MSMARCO: 0.4164/0.2731 - 1 = 52.5%. Both within the stated 52-67% range. effectiveness_evaluation_result.json also reports these exact percentages.

static_verifiable.content: 3. All results are highly consistent across random seeds (standard deviation <0.003 for Recall@10)
static_verifiable.reason: Verified across all RESULTS.json files: SIFT adj std=0.0006, SIFT unweighted std=0.001567, SIFT deg-pen std=0.003015 (~0.003, marginal), MSMARCO adj std=0.0007, MSMARCO deg-pen std=0.000339, MSMARCO unweighted std=0.002. All are at or below 0.003.
